spans.s: phāṣa, adv. phāṣam (see a-phāṣa and s.v. sparśavihāra-tā; also the following items), comfortably: KP 〔141.8〕 (prose) sukhaṃ phāṣaṃ vihariṣyāmaḥ.
phāsa, adj. (= phāṣa, phāsu; see sparśa-vihāratā), agreeable, comfortable: noted only in v.l. of Kashgar rec. -sukha-phāsa-vihārārthaṃ for SP 〔211.2〕 (prose); text omits phāsa with Nep. mss.
phāṣaka, adj. = phāṣa (as adj.): Prāt 〔513.6〕 na me … phāṣakaṃ, it is not agreeable to me.

phāsu, adj. (= Pali id.; see phāṣa, phāsa, and esp. sparśa-vihāra-tā), comfortable, agreeable: Mv 〔iii.48.12〕 phāsu-vihārāye (mss. cchāsu-, em. Senart); adv., sukhaṃ phāsuṃ viharantu Śikṣ 〔129.8〕; yathāsukhaṃ yathāphāsu Mv 〔iii.169.9〕.
